absent: Queue limits, request, bio, gendisk, block device and geometry layouts and lifecycles beyond referenced members.
Enabled block layer behavior for crypto registration, invalidation, sync, stat, partition listing and early lookup.
Blktrace relay setup, action mask bits beyond notify, and sequence handling.
Block group lock contention behavior and CPU count source.
Bootconfig tree allocation, parsing, error handling and composed key formatting.
Bottom half softirq offsets and enable path effects.
BPF program, map, link and cgroup object layouts and attach flag semantics.

findings.text: Provides two declaration helpers for block device module aliases, one specific to a major and minor pair and one wildcarded to a whole major number.

Driver operations table for block devices groups submission and polling with open and release handling, control commands, event polling, capacity unlocking, geometry and read only handling, disk freeing, swap notification, zone reporting, node naming, identifier query, ownership and reservation support plus a special alternate probe.
Unique identifier designator types are numbered one for T10, two for EUI64 and three for NAA, matching the referenced storage standard.
Swap slot free notification runs while swap lock is held and sometimes with page table lock held, so its implementation must be safe under those locks.
Alternate sector probe exists for Android style layouts and is consumed by scanning and MMC driver paths.
Crypto profile registration helper in this configuration reports success without performing work.
IO waiter wakeup marks the current task runnable directly when waiter is self for polling completions, otherwise wakes the other task.
Bio accounting completion helper forwards to remapped accounting using the stored device and supplied start time.
Largest block device identifier string is thirty two characters and largest major minor text form is ten characters.
Maximum block major number is five hundred twelve in one build variant and zero in the other build variant.
Holder operations table carries four callbacks for marking dead and for syncing freezing and thawing the filesystem on the device.
Each holder callback releases the holder lock of the supplied block device on return.
Superblock open mode helper always requests read with restricted writes and adds write unless read only flag is present.
In this configuration invalidation, multi device sync, stat extension and partition listing helpers do nothing, while single device sync helpers report success.
Early device name lookup helper reports invalid argument without resolving the pathname in this configuration.
IO completion batch groups a request list with a timestamp need flag plus a completion callback and an opaque poll context.
Helper declares a completion batch object with default empty initialization.
Atomic write support requires a nonzero hardware minimum length and for partitions additionally requires the start sector to satisfy alignment derived from hardware minimum and boundary.
Minimum and maximum atomic write length queries return zero when unsupported and otherwise return the corresponding queue limit.
Bio split helper for read write delegates to generic splitting using the limits alignment value.
Maximum block integrity payload size is two megabytes.
Maximum integrity size is the smaller of the maximum segment size and a value computed from integrity metadata size and interval exponent.
Compatibility partition argument carries operation, flags, length and data pointer using compat integer and pointer types.

Block trace descriptor holds version and state plus channel, per cpu sequence and message areas, action mask, address range, process and device identifiers, directory entry, running list and dropped counter.
Enabled trace message paths acquire read protection while loading the queue trace pointer and release afterwards.
Maximum block trace note message length is one hundred twenty eight bytes.

When tracing is enabled message helpers forward to the note routine if a trace object exists and enablement reflects the notify action bit, while the disabled build turns setup start stop and removal into errors and turns message and shutdown helpers into empty operations.
Compatibility trace setup carries device name, action mask, buffer size and count, start and end addresses and process identifier with compat wide address fields.
Thirty two bit compatibility trace setup command uses magic eighteen hex and number one hundred fifteen with the compat setup layout.
Trace sector and sector count helpers report zero for passthrough requests and for unset start position, otherwise they report request position and length.
Block group lock count is one in the simple variant and four times a power of two derived from CPU count capped at thirty two in the scaled variant.
Group locking uses an aligned single lock wrapper repeated into an array sized by the configured lock count.
Group lock initializer prepares every array element lock.
Group to lock mapping selects an array slot by masking the group number with one less than the lock count.
Boot configuration magic marker length is twelve with four byte alignment derived from shift two and a mask of alignment minus one.
Boot configuration node is packed and holds four sixteen bit indices for next sibling, child, parent and data payload.
Key marker value is zero and value marker is the high bit of sixteen bits.
Boot configuration limits allow data index below high bit minus one, up to eight thousand nodes, key length up to two hundred fifty six and nesting depth up to sixteen.
A node is a value when its data high bit is set and a key otherwise, an array when it is a value with a child, and a leaf key when it has no child or its child is a value.
Boot configuration checksum is the unsigned thirty two bit sum of all input bytes starting from zero.
Top level value, node key and compose helpers delegate to generic node search and composition using a null root.
Subkey accessor returns the first child unless that child is a value, in which case it skips to the following sibling.

Iteration helpers walk array values by child links, children and subkeys by next links, keyed array values by search then child descent, and key value pairs by repeated next key search from global or supplied root.
Exit helper delegates with false, embedded configuration accessor reports absent, command line prepend does nothing and applied query reports false in this configuration.
Bottom half disable adds to the preempt count with a compiler barrier while enable balances it, and the blocked query reports false in this configuration.
Number of cgroup LSM attachment slots is ten in one variant and zero in the other.

Cgroup attachment enumeration starts from an invalid sentinel then covers socket and networking lifecycle operations followed by device and control groups before a contiguous LSM range closed by a maximum sentinel.

Full cgroup state holds per type effective arrays and attached lists with flags and revisions plus shared storage list, inactive array, reference count and release work, while the alternate variant is an empty placeholder.
Attachment conversion maps each recognized type to the matching internal enumerator and returns invalid for unrecognized inputs.

Cgroup storage groups a reference counted flexible buffer with map backed descriptors holding map, key and list and tree links, plus link objects binding programs to groups and program list entries with flags and per type storage.
Storage type helper selects per cpu storage for per cpu maps and shared storage otherwise.
Socket attachment enablement holds when the socket group effective array for the requested type differs from the shared empty array.
Helper reports whether the static branch for a given attachment type is enabled.
Compatibility pointer helper is defined as null in this configuration.
Headers use standard include guards that define a unique macro on first inclusion.
